To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

ProFAL: 1) is able to retrieve and extract relevant information from online databases; 2) provides an efficient way to automatically annotate biological databases; and 3) provides a way to validate the automatic annotations.

ProFAL is a system for the automatic and semi-automatic annotation of biological databases, using text mining and manual curation, which provides a set of heuristics to validate the annotations, and which is able to annotate the gene products in the Swissprot and the KEGG databases with a precision of 0.85 and a recall of 0.75.

ProFAL can: (a) retrieve and process documents related to a gene-product from online databases, and extract functional properties from their texts, (b) validate the extracted properties, and (c) provide a specific interface for the validation of the extracted properties by human curators.

the development of a system that automatically annotates a biological database using a set of Bioinformatics methods, which is validated and manually curated.
the automatic annotation of databases with functional properties.
the development and evaluation of a novel approach for the automatic annotation of biological data.
